integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically from finite-character duality and the exact singular values of a two-by-two Fourier restriction matrix. The checker is finite and is used only as a sanity test.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to subsets of cardinality \(2\).
It does not classify the tightness quantities for cardinality \(3\) or larger.
The literature search was targeted; non-indexed equivalent formulations remain a residual originality risk.
title: Complete two-point tightness profile in finite abelian groups
